source.title: Regulation (EU) 2022/2554 of the European Parliament and of the Council on digital operational resilience in the financial sector (DORA)
source.publisher: Publications Office of the European Union
source.applicability: Primary legal instrument establishing ICT risk management requirements for financial entities (Articles 1-5, 16), defining critical ICT third-party providers, and setting governance obligations for management bodies. Defines entity scope, proportionality considerations, and simplified framework applicability.
